title: Add string resource info_developer_options_body
description: Add the string resource used to localize "Down at the bottom of Settings is a locked "Developer Options" section — it holds Delete All Data and JSON backup/restore, all of which can overwrite or erase your quests for good. Press and hold its header to unlock it; you'll be asked to confirm before it opens. It re-locks the next time you open Settings, so a stray tap can't land on Delete All Data by accident.".
